text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
During my time off, I tried coming up with 
a new original coffee blend...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It turned out to be a real masterpiece... 
If you'd like, would you care to have a 
drink together...?

Having spent a fulfilling day off, 
Manhattan Cafe seems to have recharged her 
energy.
